pages.title: North Meridian — Small-batch specialty coffee roasting

sections.copy: We roast small batches of single-origin specialty coffee in Portland, Oregon. Each cup is crafted with care, from bean to brew. Discover the richness of coffee made by hand.
Featured in Portland Monthly, The Oregonian, and The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
Inline SVG icons: hand-picked beans, small-batch roasting, Portland-based, direct trade, third-wave coffee, and sustainable packaging
1. Source beans directly from small farms. 2. Roast in small batches to preserve flavor. 3. Deliver fresh coffee to your door.
‘North Meridian’s coffee is a revelation — it tastes like the mountains where it was grown.’ — Portland Coffee Club

1. What beans do you source? <details> <summary>Click to see</summary> We source single-origin beans from small farms in Colombia, Ethiopia, and Guatemala.</details>
2. How do you roast your beans? <details> <summary>Click to see</summary> We use a small-batch roaster to ensure each batch is roasted to perfection.</details>
3. Do you offer subscriptions? <details> <summary>Click to see</summary> Yes, we offer monthly subscription options for coffee lovers.</details>
Contact: info@northmeridian.com | Follow us: inline SVG social icons | © 2025 North Meridian
